# BOKKO

> Hospitality marketing agency based in Bangkok, Thailand. BOKKO helps restaurants, hotels, cafés, bars, and travel brands grow through content production, performance advertising, influencer campaigns, and brand growth strategy — built around measurable revenue results, not just reach or impressions.

## Services
- Social Media Growth — content planning, copywriting, publishing, platform management
- Creative Production — photography, reels, video, campaign assets
- Performance Advertising — Meta, TikTok, and Google campaigns focused on bookings and revenue
- Influencer Campaigns — creator partnerships for awareness and demand
- Brand Growth Strategy — launches, revamps, seasonal campaigns

## Track record
- 80+ hospitality clients served
- 120m+ THB in ad spend managed
- Up to 60.3x average ROAS on individual campaigns
- 9+ years of hospitality marketing experience
- Example results: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok (60.3x ROAS, ฿6m+ sold in 24 hours), Thai Airways (114x record ROAS, ฿50m sales in 4 months), Opera Italian Restaurant (250% growth in 3 months), Pi Samui Beach Club (monthly revenue grew from ฿2m to ฿6m)

## Pricing
Main package (BOKKO Hospitality Growth) starts at ฿85,000/month, 3-month minimum, ad spend and VAT not included. Add-ons available for Google Search & Maps growth, LINE OA setup, KOL campaign management, extra production days, and website/landing page builds.
